scripts.dev: docker compose up -d db && until docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d connected_in_climate -c 'SELECT 1' 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.go: docker compose up -d db && until docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d connected_in_climate -c 'SELECT 1' 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done && npm run import -- scripts/sample-profiles.csv && npm run dev
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && echo 'DB wiped. Run npm run go to start fresh.'
scripts.test:api: node --env-file=.env --test --test-concurrency=1 server/match-api.test.js server/action-feedback-api.test.js server/admin-api.test.js server/auth.test.js server/profile-api.test.js
scripts.test:all: node --test server/field-registry.test.js server/matching.test.js && npm run test:api && npm run test:email
